Run-rate estimate = MTD GMV ÷ days elapsed × days in month (the team's own method). Growth compares like-for-like same dates vs last month (LM GMV). Ad Contri = Ad Sales ÷ current GMV. Amazon GMV (and Blinkit ad spend) arrive on a T-2 lag, so the latest 1–2 days are pending, not a drop. Amazon Core, NOW+Fresh, Flipkart, Minutes, First Club are reviewed monthly, shown as MTD totals (no daily split). Shopify is D2C: GMV = gross sales. Figures read from a read-only snapshot of the source sheets; no data is altered or invented.
⚠ Excel estimate day-counts to refresh: Blinkit (÷6→7), Big Basket (÷6→7), Zepto (÷6→7). The report already uses the correct data-driven day-counts; this flags the source sheet.
